english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a significant effect or influence on someone or something.
Use 影響 as the all-purpose noun for both the power to affect someone or something and the person or thing exerting that influence.
This is the all-purpose choice for an effect or result, especially when discussing what an action means for people or the environment.
Use this when “difference” means an effect or impact on a situation or person.
Use this for the influence one thing has on another, especially in everyday explanations.
Use this for the effect or impact something has, rather than for the resulting outcome itself.

examples.english: The impact this film had on me was profound.
examples.traditional: 呢套戲對我嘅影響好深。
examples.jyutping: ni1 tou3 hei3 deoi3 ngo5 ge3 jing2 hoeng2 hou2 sam1

examples.english: This TV drama has a big influence on teenagers.
examples.traditional: 呢套劇對青少年嘅影響好大。
examples.jyutping: ni1 tou3 kek6 deoi3 cing1 siu3 nin4 ge3 jing2 hoeng2 hou2 daai6

examples.english: This decision could have a major implication for the lives of nearby residents.
examples.traditional: 呢個決定可能會對附近居民嘅生活造成好大影響。
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 kyut3 ding6 ho2 nang4 wui5 deoi3 fu6 gan6 geoi1 man4 ge3 saang1 wut6 zou6 sing4 hou2 daai6 jing2 hoeng2

examples.english: This heavy rain makes a big difference to traffic.
examples.traditional: 呢場大雨對交通嘅影響好大。
examples.jyutping: ni1 coeng4 daai6 jyu5 deoi3 gaau1 tung1 ge3 jing2 hoeng2 hou2 daai6

examples.english: The effect of not getting enough sleep can be seen in your energy the next day.
examples.traditional: 瞓得唔夠會影響第二日嘅精神。
examples.jyutping: fan3 dak1 m4 gau3 wui5 jing2 hoeng2 dai6 ji6 jat6 ge3 zing1 san4

examples.jyutping: ni1 ci3 ting4 din6 deoi3 fu6 gan6 di1 dim3 jing2 hoeng2 hou2 daai6
